Forbes put Elon Musk’s net worth at $915.4 billion on September 28, 2026, and Bloomberg had Musk at $924 billion four days earlier. Both are estimates built from share prices, since no filing, court record or audit confirms Musk’s total wealth.
Key facts about Elon Musk’s net worth
Reported net worth | About $915.4 billion (Forbes, Sept. 28, 2026) |
Full name | Elon Reeve Musk |
Born | June 28, 1971, Pretoria, South Africa (age 55) |
Primary income source | Stakes in SpaceX and Tesla; no Tesla salary |
Education | University of Pennsylvania |
Marital status | Divorced; 14 publicly known children |
How much is Elon Musk worth, and who does the counting
Forbes and Bloomberg price Musk’s public stakes at the market, estimate the private ones, and subtract known debt. On September 6, 2026, their totals were $904 billion and $908 billion, according to Wikipedia’s summary of both indexes.
SpaceX is most of the number. The Forbes profile counts a 38% SpaceX stake including options and nearly 11% of Tesla, before unvested restricted stock that could add about 8% more.
Musk also owns pieces of Neuralink and The Boring Company. Both are private and publish no financials, so any dollar figure for them is an outside guess.
What made up Elon Musk’s net worth on Aug. 1, 2026
Bloomberg’s split of a $684 billion total, in billions of U.S. dollars
Source: Bloomberg Billionaires Index, as reported by Fortune on Aug. 1, 2026. Figures are estimates. “Other” covers Neuralink, The Boring Company and cash, which Bloomberg did not itemize. No newer dollar breakdown has been published.
Who is Elon Musk, and where the first money came from
Elon Musk made about $180 million when eBay bought PayPal in October 2002. PayPal had formed from a merger with X.com, the online bank Musk started in 1999, as PayPal’s ownership history shows.
That money went into SpaceX, founded in 2002, and Tesla, which Musk backed in 2004 and has run as CEO since 2008. Forbes first listed Musk as a billionaire in 2012, at $2 billion.
Tesla carried the next decade. Its market value went from $75.7 billion at the end of 2019 to $1.06 trillion two years later, per Tesla’s year-by-year market capitalization .
Elon Musk today runs SpaceX, which now includes xAI and X, and is still Tesla’s CEO.
Elon Musk net worth 2025 vs. 2026: the SpaceX swing
Private share sales did the work in 2025. Forbes had Musk at 500billioninOctoberand 677 billion on December 15, after a tender offer valued SpaceX at $800 billion.
In February 2026, SpaceX acquired xAI, which already owned the former Twitter. That deal pushed Forbes’ estimate past $800 billion; the earlier step is covered in how X ended up inside xAI .
SpaceX priced its IPO at $135 a share on June 11, valuing the company near $1.77 trillion, CNN reported . Shares reached $225.64 on June 16, and Bloomberg’s estimate peaked near $1.33 trillion.
The fall took about six weeks. By August 1, Bloomberg had Musk at $684 billion, and Forbes had the figure back at $892 bill

Celebrity , Finance , Investing
Elon Musk’s Net Worth 2026: Tesla, SpaceX & X Holdings
March 18, 2026
George Windsor
Elon Musk Estimated Net Worth 2026: Breaking Down Tesla Equity, SpaceX Valuation, and X Holdings
As of March 2026, Elon Musk’s estimated net worth sits between $676 billion (Bloomberg Billionaires Index, conservative estimate) and $852 billion (Forbes Real-Time Billionaires), making him the wealthiest individual ever recorded in either index. The $176 billion gap between those two figures is not a rounding error — it reflects genuine methodological disagreement about how to value private companies before an IPO, how to treat unvested equity, and whether to discount future compensation packages.
His wealth is concentrated in three primary assets: an approximate 13–17% stake in Tesla, a ~43% ownership stake in the newly merged SpaceX-xAI entity, and a controlling position in X Holdings (formerly Twitter). Nearly 95% of that figure consists of unrealized equity gains — meaning Musk remains largely illiquid despite holding wealth that exceeds the GDP of many mid-size economies.
This article breaks down each wealth driver with current estimates, outlines the key events that drove a $200+ billion increase in early 2026, and explains why analysts disagree so sharply on the final number.
Disclaimer: All net worth figures are estimates based on publicly reported data as of March 2026. This article is not financial advice.
Elon Musk’s Estimated 2026 Net Worth: The Quick Breakdown
Two headline figures dominate coverage of Musk’s 2026 wealth:
Bloomberg Billionaires Index: ~$676 billion (conservative; applies private company discounts and excludes contingent compensation)
Forbes Real-Time Billionaires: ~$852 billion (uses full SpaceX-xAI merged valuation and includes majority of Tesla compensation package value)
The bulk of the early-2026 wealth surge — estimated at over $200 billion — came from two events:
The February 2026 SpaceX-xAI all-stock merger , which valued the combined private entity at approximately $1.25 trillion
The late-February 2026 Delaware court reinstatement of Musk’s ~$1 trillion Tesla compensation package, which had been initially blocked in January 2026
The wealth gap between Musk and the second-richest person — Google co-founder Larry Page, estimated at approximately $250–281 billion — now exceeds $400–600 billion depending on the index used. By comparison, previous gaps between the #1 and #2 billionaires (e.g., Bezos vs. Gates in the early 2010s) typically ranged from $50 billion to $150 billion. Musk’s current lead is historically unprecedented.
One critical caveat applies to all of these figures: approximately 95% of Musk’s net worth consists of unrealized equity gains . He does not hold a cash reserve proportionate to his net worth. Musk himself has described his financial position as “cash poor” — a structural reality that creates both volatility risk and liquidity mismatch.

Methodology
Where this number comes from
One source, fetched daily
We read Elon Musk's finalWorth from the Forbes Real-Time Billionaires
API once a day and rebuild the whole site from it. Nothing on this page is hand-typed or estimated by us.
Validated before it ships
Each fetch is retried and checked against a plausible range before it is accepted. A wild value from a
broken upstream response is rejected rather than published.
Stale data is labelled, not hidden
If every source fails we keep the last known figure and mark it stale instead of showing an invented
number, and that day is not written into the history table above.
